items.q: they put Trummy in there, you know, Trummy and Wells. And then when I left the band

ctx.x: So he'd played a little. But anyhow, he didn't have too much of that to do, when Trummy come in and tried to put on a third trombone, and they put Trummy in there, you know, Trummy and Wells. And then when I left the band, he brought in Steve, and Steve, that was a great thing. He'd never heard nobody hit no high note like that. Tommy Stevenson?
